Our genomics lab has five git repositories under /opt/genomics-repos/ that need automated syncing. Here's our policy:

- pipeline-aligner (branch: main) — should sync actively
- variant-caller (branch: develop) — should sync actively
- qc-dashboard (branch: main) — should sync actively
- legacy-assembler (branch: master) — currently in maintenance; sync must be paused but we want to keep it in the config so we can re-enable it later without re-registering
- ref-genome-tools — decommissioned; do not include it at all

Please use the sync management scripts in ./scripts/ to set all this up. Register the appropriate repositories with the right branch settings, make sure legacy-assembler is paused (not deleted from config), and confirm the whole thing works by running a one-time sync cycle. The scripts already exist — just use them.
